Subject: Discovery follow-up & demo scheduling - Acme Corp

Hi Alex / Sara -

Great meeting earlier today - thanks for taking the time. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: in-product summarization + search for customer support tickets (~3M records, 12-18 month retention).
- Latency target: sub-300ms token latency for 95th percentile on critical routes.
- Data residency: US, with potential move to EU later this year.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in average handle time, <5% regression in summary accuracy vs. current baseline.

Next step: we'd like to run a technical deep dive / demo focused on architecture, throughput testing plan, and rollout options (Hosted vs Dedicated). Proposed slots (60 min):

- Tue, Mar 14 - 10:00-11:00 PT
- Thu, Mar 16 - 09:00-10:00 PT

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend? Also let us know any specific areas to prioritize (security, throughput, or integration).

I've attached the discovery notes from today's call for your reference.

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: ACME_Discovery_Notes.pdf (summary of call, high-level requirements).
